description: Saved YouTube Analytics reports for the account's connected channel (account-level, not per site): fixed 7/28/90-day totals with YouTube's own previous-period total, traffic sources and countries per period, plus up to 90 daily rows. Metrics: views, estimated minutes watched, subscribers gained/lost, likes, comments, shares, average view duration, average percentage viewed. Exact provider numbers; missing is not zero; no change is computed between periods. Days use America/Los_Angeles. sync.stale flags reports over 36h old. daily=false skips daily rows. Read-only; never calls YouTube.

format.description: Output shape: table (default) or raw json.

period.description: YouTube's fixed report window in days: 7, 28 or 90.

name: get_youtube_channel_report
title: Get YouTube channel report
